subject.title: fix(ai): provider-billed totals desync the cost breakdown and drop cache writes

question: Should OpenClaw make `Usage.cost.estimatedTotal` a supported plugin-SDK and persisted worker-transcript field, or should this PR limit itself to cache-write and overflow correctness?
rationale: The added field is optional and mechanically propagated, but it establishes a new durable distinction between catalog estimates and authoritative billed totals across plugin and worker boundaries; source inspection alone cannot choose that product/API contract.

options.title: Sponsor the public estimate field
options.body: Accept `estimatedTotal` as the documented companion to provider-billed `total`, then require clear API/upgrade semantics and current-base protocol coverage before merge.

options.title: Split the API expansion
options.body: Keep the cache-write and overflow bug fixes in a narrower PR, and discuss the public retained-estimate contract separately with its intended consumers.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the public estimate field
recommendation.body: Accept `estimatedTotal` as the documented companion to provider-billed `total`, then require clear API/upgrade semantics and current-base protocol coverage before merge.
